market: Deribit BTC options; not US-listed utility evidence
selection: Complete first-day discovery; retain only frozen activity threshold passers; rank fresh-anchor bins descending, active-feature bins descending, eligible-trade count descending, instrument name ascending; choose first four satisfying validated inverse-BTC metadata, expiry strictly after panel end, creation no later than panel start.

forecast.reference: Last eligible trade with event timestamp <= cutoff and age <=30min at cutoff
forecast.target: Last eligible trade in (decision, decision+30min]; decision=cutoff+60sec; target interval entirely inside panel
forecast.estimand: Log target trade price minus log last available reference trade price, conditional on eligible future trade arrival; absence is missing, never zero
forecast.availability: Historical event-time + assumed60sec lag; no receipt-time claim

completion_policy: Any budget exhaustion, unresolved discovery tie, inconsistent sequence, metadata mismatch or acquisition error makes panel incomplete and ineligible for fitting
execution: Frozen public unauthenticated acquisition; invoke only through the bound contained execution plan. No purchases or orders.
utility_scope: Separate flow-information/no-flow-ablation assessment from sampler accuracy, reliability and workflow cost. Weak or zero flow findings can be useful; no alpha/profit requirement.
grid_policy: Preserve scheduled grid, missing masks and all-origin denominator. No zero-fill, imputation or compressed irregular rows. Existing balanced-panel ingest cannot fit missing outcomes; require explicit validated masked likelihood/new adapter before fitting.
phase_purge: Exclude training/validation outcomes whose assumed availability extends past phase boundary or held-out origin.
pagination: Expand first/last timestamp probes to complete tie pages; freeze min/max sequence; sequence-only pages validate duplicates and range then sort locally; require overlap and contiguous final sequence set. Saturated timestamp ties fail incomplete.

execution_containment.scope: Whole collector process including discovery, retries, metadata, history and output. This timeout is enforced externally, not by the collector protocol parser. Never invoke unwrapped.
execution_containment.failure_policy: Wrapper timeout, missing terminal summary or non-complete summary means incomplete acquisition, never fit eligible; preserve all requests and source snapshots; no automatic retry.

activity_rationale.purpose: Thirty-minute repeated decisions should have known recent price anchors in at least roughly three quarters of selection bins and nonempty fifteen-minute flow features in at least roughly half. At least96eligible prints over24h prevents satisfying occupancy criteria with only a few isolated trades. Future activity is not guaranteed.

evaluation_policy: Fixed chronological development48h/validation24h/evaluation96h from panel start. Selection finishes first24h plus60sec assumed lag; no pre-selection operational claim. Preserve scheduled origins and all missing anchors/targets; no selection by future returns, volume or scoring availability.
window_choice: Fixed September 11-18, 2026 UTC week, disjoint from inspected September 25-October 2 panel. No proposed-week trades or outcomes inspected before choosing it.
retry_policy: No lowering thresholds, replacing week, expanding budgets, or swapping selected names after outcomes are inspected within this protocol. An insufficient universe is a retained negative feasibility result.
